findings.message: Design system defines 12 colors, 11 typography scales, 5 rounding levels, 3 spacing tokens, 29 components.
Design system defines 12 colors, 11 typography scales, 5 rounding levels, 3 spacing tokens, 29 components.

accepted.colors.surface: Aether's window fill is 98% opaque; the demo uses color-mix(surface-solid 92%, transparent). This is the open backdrop-blur item (V8).
accepted.spacing.dock: Aether paints 8px of inner padding; the demo's 7px plus its 1px border gives the same visible inset.
accepted.components.dock: Cascades from spacing.dock and the dock height difference (62 vs 64).
accepted.components.dock-item: Aether ships 46px dock items; the demo uses 48px. Tracked with the dock parity work.
accepted.components.dock-tile: Aether ships 38px tiles; the demo uses 48 x 0.82 = 39.36px.
accepted.components.tray-calendar: Whole-pixel rounding: the demo computes 350.41px, Aether 351px.
accepted.colors.line-strong: The demo's computed hairline is 77/255 after color-mix; Aether paints 76/255. A 1/255 rounding difference.
